input.question: When did Cosimo de' Medici become Grand Duke of Tuscany?

documents.text: Tuscany ( 1569–74 ) . The son of Giovanni de ’ Medici , Cosimo became head of the Florentine republic in 1537 after the assassination of his distant cousin Alessandro de ’ Medici . He continued Alessandro ’ s tyrannical rule and defeated attempts to oust him with aid from Emperor Charles V . Seeking to expand his power , he attacked Siena in 1554 and brought nearly all of Tuscany under his control .
